descriptions.value: The Magee Shortcodes WordPress plugin through 2.1.1 does not sanitise and escape user input in some of its AJAX actions, which are available to unauthenticated users, before reflecting it back in the response, leading to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting.

assertions.title: Magee Shortcodes <= 2.1.1 - Reflected XSS via live_preview and magee_create_shortcode Actions

descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: Magee Shortcodes <= 2.1.1 - Reflected XSS via live_preview and magee_create_shortcode Actions

descriptions.value: Use after free in Extensions in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.47 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)
